+ "e){}\n}\n\n\n\n/* ---- V34 GEOMETRIA (sem DOM): poligonos, uniao exata ---- */\nfunction g34Area(P){var a=0,n=P.length;for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var p=P[i],q=P[(i+1)%n];a+=p.x*q.y-q.x*p.y;}return a/2;}\nfunction g34Cross(ax,ay,bx,by){return ax*by-ay*bx;}\nfunction g34Split(P,Q,eps){\n  var out=[],n=P.length,m=Q.length;\n  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){\n    var a=P[i],b=P[(i+1)%n],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,len2=dx*dx+dy*dy;\n    if(len2<1e-12)continue;\n    var len=Math.sqrt(len2),ts=[0,1];\n    for(var j=0;j<m;j++){\n      var c=Q[j],d=Q[(j+1)%m],ex=d.x-c.x,ey=d.y-c.y,elen=Math.sqrt(ex*ex+ey*ey);\n      if(elen<1e-12)continue;\n      var den=g34Cross(dx,dy,ex,ey);\n      if(Math.abs(den)>1e-9*len*elen){\n        var t=g34Cross(c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y,ex,ey)/den,u=g34Cross(c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y,dx,dy)/den;\n        var te=eps/len,ue=eps/elen;\n        if(t>-te&&t<1+te&&u>-ue&&u<1+ue){ts.push(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t)));}\n      }else{\n      "
+ "  var dist=Math.abs(g34Cross(c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y,dx,dy))/len;\n        if(dist<eps){\n          var rr=[c,d];\n          for(var k=0;k<2;k++){var tt=((rr[k].x-a.x)*dx+(rr[k].y-a.y)*dy)/len2;if(tt>0&&tt<1)ts.push(tt);}\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    ts.sort(function(x,y){return x-y;});\n    var prev=ts[0];\n    for(var s=1;s<ts.length;s++){\n      var t1=ts[s];\n      if((t1-prev)*len>eps){\n        out.push({a:{x:a.x+dx*prev,y:a.y+dy*prev},b:{x:a.x+dx*t1,y:a.y+dy*t1}});\n        prev=t1;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction g34Where(p,Q,eps){\n  var n=Q.length,inside=false;\n  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){\n    var a=Q[i],b=Q[(i+1)%n],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,len2=dx*dx+dy*dy;\n    if(len2>1e-12){\n      var t=((p.x-a.x)*dx+(p.y-a.y)*dy)/len2;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));\n      var ex=a.x+dx*t-p.x,ey=a.y+dy*t-p.y;\n      if(ex*ex+ey*ey<eps*eps)return{s:\"on\",dx:dx,dy:dy};\n    }\n    if(((a.y>p.y)!==(b.y>p.y))&&(p.x<("
